meta.subject: Fix packing order of GPU-in data, attempt #2

en.summary: Fixes GPU-input lane packing by removing an incorrect per-group reversal before buffered 16-bit values are cast into the accelerator’s internal half-row type.
why_it_counts: The patch changes DUT data ordering in MxRequantizer rather than tests or debug output.
The bug is a concrete element-ordering error on the GPU input path.
The commit message explicitly identifies a packing-order fix.
evidence: The old code grouped the combined 16-bit values and reversed each group before flattening into the internal type.
The fix replaces that logic with VecInit(combined).asTypeOf(half_acc_row_t).
The removed comment said the reversal was intended to match later unpacking, so the patch changes true lane-order semantics rather than style.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This is a classic packer/unpacker ordering bug. A front-end path collects several subwords, then casts or concatenates them into the internal row type consumed by later quantization or compute logic. The broken version reversed element order inside each machine-word group before the cast, while downstream logic expected the original arrival order. Any DUT that batches input lanes into wider words can suffer the same silent permutation bug.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: lane-order packing from buffered subwords into an internal row vector
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Input data arrives as multiple smaller elements that are buffered and then packed into a wider internal row or lane group.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reintroduce a local reversal or permutation within each packed group before casting or concatenating into the internal row representation.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: reverse subword order inside each packing group
portability_notes: This applies to GPU ingest, DMA unpack, vector lane packers, and any row builder that converts a list of subwords into a wider physical word.
The bug is easiest to observe when downstream unpacking or quantization assumes stable lane order but does not explicitly correct it.
If your DUT uses concatenation instead of type casts, inject the same fault by swapping the concatenation order within each local group.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that buffers a set of smaller input elements and then packs them into a wider internal row or register type.
Partition the buffered elements into the natural machine-word groups used by the packer and reverse the order inside each group before the final cast or concatenation.
Leave downstream unpacking unchanged so the bug appears as a deterministic element permutation.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix removes grouped reverse logic on GPU input data and directly casts VecInit(combined) into half_acc_row_t.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In the GPU-input path of MxRequantizer, reintroduce the grouped-per-accType reversal of combined before casting it into half_acc_row_t.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: GPU-provided elements are stored in the wrong lane order, so later unpacking, quantization, or compute consumes a deterministic but incorrect permutation of the input data.
evidence_for_injection: The only functional change is removal of the grouped reverse before packing.
The internal target type half_acc_row_t remains the same, so the bug is purely element ordering.
The deleted comment explicitly documents that the old reversal was intended to compensate for a later unpacking assumption.
notes: No other logic needs to change to recreate this fault.
This is a good reusable injection for pack/unpack correctness bugs.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 GPU 输入 lane 打包顺序错误：在把缓存的 16 位值转换成加速器内部 half-row 类型之前，不应该对每个分组做局部反转。
why_it_counts: 补丁改变的是 MxRequantizer 中 DUT 的数据顺序，而不是测试或调试输出。
这个错误是在 GPU 输入路径上具有明确语义的元素顺序错误。
提交信息明确指出是 packing order fix。
evidence: 旧代码会先把合并后的 16 位值按组划分，再在每组内部 reverse 后打平成内部类型。
修复把这段逻辑替换成了 VecInit(combined).asTypeOf(half_acc_row_t)。
被删除的注释说明原先的 reverse 是为了配合后续 unpack，因此补丁改变的是实际 lane 顺序语义，而不是风格。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 这是一个典型的 packer/unpacker 顺序错误。前端路径会先收集多个子字，再把它们 cast 或拼接成供后续量化或计算逻辑使用的内部行类型。错误版本在 cast 之前对每个机器字分组内部的元素顺序做了反转，而下游逻辑却假设仍保持原始到达顺序。任何把输入 lane 批量打包成更宽字的 DUT 都可能出现这种无声的数据置换错误。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 把缓冲子字打包成内部行向量时的 lane 顺序
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 输入数据以多个较小元素的形式到达，先被缓存，然后再打包成更宽的内部行或 lane 组。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在最终 cast 或拼接成内部行表示之前，重新引入每个打包分组内部的局部 reverse 或固定置换。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 对每个打包分组内部的子字顺序做反转
portability_notes: 可用于 GPU 输入、DMA 解包、向量 lane packer，以及任何把一串子字转换成更宽物理字的行构造器。
当下游 unpack 或量化默认 lane 顺序稳定、却不会显式修正顺序时，这个错误最容易观察到。
如果你的 DUT 用显式拼接而不是类型转换，就通过调换每个局部分组内的拼接顺序来注入同类错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把一组较小输入元素缓存后再打包成更宽内部行或寄存器类型的逻辑。
按照 packer 自然使用的机器字分组划分这些缓存元素，并在最终 cast 或拼接前把每组内部的顺序反转。
保持下游 unpack 逻辑不变，使错误表现为确定性的元素置换。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: MxRequantizer 中 GPU 输入到 half_acc_row_t 的打包逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复删除了 GPU 输入数据按组 reverse 的逻辑，改为直接把 VecInit(combined) 转成 half_acc_row_t。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 MxRequantizer 的 GPU 输入路径上，重新引入把 combined 按 accType 分组并逐组 reverse 后再转换为 half_acc_row_t 的逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: GPU 提供的元素会以错误的 lane 顺序存入内部行，导致后续 unpack、量化或计算阶段读取到一种固定但错误的输入置换。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁唯一的功能变化，就是删除了打包前的分组 reverse。
内部目标类型 half_acc_row_t 没有变化，因此错误纯粹是元素顺序问题。
被删除的注释明确记录了旧 reverse 是为了补偿后续 unpack 假设。
notes: 无需修改其他逻辑即可复现该故障。
这是一个很适合作为 pack/unpack 正确性错误的可复用注入样本。
